name: The Rescue
summary: In Tarren Mill, Krusk needs your help after Syndicate bandits seize the orc scouts sent to Durnholde Keep. Thrall sent them to investigate the growing threat and retrieve an object from the keep.

sections.title: A Scout Mission Gone Wrong
sections.body: Warchief Thrall sent orc warriors to Hillsbrad Foothills to investigate the growing Syndicate threat and retrieve an object from Durnholde Keep. Gol'dir led them toward the fortress ruins, but the Syndicate overwhelmed the scouts in an ambush. Krusk broke free and limped back across the river to Tarren Mill. The human bandits captured Drull, Tog'thar, and Gol'dir.

sections.title: Chains in the Ruins
sections.body: Durnholde holds bitter memories for the orcs. Aedelas Blackmoore once kept captive orcs there in internment camps, where they were made lethargic and forced into gladiatorial slavery. Now Drull and Tog'thar are bound in iron within the keep's cracked stone walls. Free them from the Syndicate jailors who hold the keys to their shackles, then learn what became of their commander, Gol'dir.

faq.q: Why were orcs sent into Durnholde Keep in the first place?
faq.answer: Thrall sent Gol'dir and his scouts to investigate the Syndicate bandits and retrieve an object from Durnholde Keep.

faq.q: Who are the captives being rescued?
faq.answer: Drull and Tog'thar are orc scouts sent by the Horde under Gol'dir's command. Syndicate brigands overwhelmed them and bound them in ball and chain inside the ruins.

faq.q: Where is the squad's leader, Gol'dir?
faq.answer: After Drull and Tog'thar are freed, Krusk discovers that the Syndicate separated Gol'dir from the main party and moved him to an unknown second location.

faq.q: Who is holding the scouts captive?
faq.answer: The Syndicate holds the scouts. This aristocratic criminal network operates from the ruins of Lordaeron and Alterac, and its jailors guard the captives inside Durnholde.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead?
faq.answer: Freeing the scouts leads to a search for Gol'dir and an effort to track down and infiltrate the Syndicate. The trail reaches deeper into the Syndicate's affairs.

faq.q: Why does Durnholde Keep hold special meaning to the Horde?
faq.answer: Durnholde was where Aedelas Blackmoore raised Thrall as a gladiator and commanded the Alliance internment camps after the Second War. Thrall led a rebellion and laid waste to the keep.

angles.text: As an orc, seeing your warriors shackled in Durnholde recalls the painful history of internment. Freeing them is personal.
As a member of the Horde, you join an early effort to counter the Syndicate's expansion across Lordaeron's contested hills.
As a warrior, you stand with fellow fighters and free them from captivity at the hands of dishonorable human bandits.
